mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_authoring_candidate (principal_member_id, merchant_row_id, owner_member_id, facts_json, facts_hash, constraints_json, constraints_hash, ai_trace_id, template_json, created_at) VALUES (#{principalMemberId}, #{merchantRowId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{factsJson}, #{factsHash}, #{constraintsJson}, #{constraintsHash}, #{aiTraceId}, #{templateJson}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO merchant_authoring_source (candidate_id, owner_member_id, merchant_row_id, actual_template_id, template_snapshot_json, template_content_hash, confirmation_hash, content_hash, source_json, created_at) VALUES (#{candidateId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{merchantRowId}, #{actualTemplateId}, #{templateSnapshotJson}, #{templateContentHash}, #{confirmationHash}, #{contentHash}, #{sourceJson}, #{createdAt})
